propositions: The ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name already correctly detects attribute-form wrapper calls but this behavior is undocumented and untested, creating the impression of a gap
All eight existing R2 tests in test_raw_git_write_lint.py use only the bare ast.Name form, leaving attribute-form detection implicitly covered but unpinned
Four new tests must pin attribute-form detection: literal mutation verbs, receiver-shape independence, fail-closed opaque argv with marker silencing, and the push_lease_cas negative case
The module docstring of check_raw_git_writes.py must be updated to explicitly state that the WRAPPER_NAMES match comes from the callable attribute, not the receiver
_ref_lock_push.py has no hits not because attribute calls escape but because push is not in MUTATION_VERBS, a correct decision that must be explicitly dispositioned
